newsitem.title: POLAND: Animex mulls raising stake in meat firm.
newsitem.headline: Animex mulls raising stake in meat firm.

text.p: Polish food trader and producer Animex SA plans to up its stake in meat firm Constar by buying shares from majority owner Epstein Engineering Export Ltd of the United States, Animex's marketing director said on Tuesday.
"Epstein proposed selling some of their shares in that firm...(and) initial negotiations have begun," Halina Baltowska told Reuters.
Epstein holds 51 percent of Constar, whose full name is Zaklady Miesne Constar w Starachowicach, and Animex has 49.
Baltowska also said Animex's claim of 17 million zlotys in receivables from the government for importing grain from 1984 to 1989 could be satisfied early next year.
On Tuesday the daily Parkiet quoted Animex President Witold Pereta as saying an agreement could be reached in January.
